Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · the dialog look tightened after Attio (no background blur, lighter overlay, a two-layer border, white body, width by field count, smaller controls, a 「连续创建」 option); maintainer: 「立卡」 after the six points; filed by the coordinator under its topic → p2 as set by the coordinator · size M.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T08:25Z
Area: b1-CX
Session: `session_01L6bhgWL2r2CuFr34ENybDB` (card thread, dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-fpkoyo
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface:
- the dialog components: `dialog.tsx` and `alert-dialog.tsx` in the shadcn sync area, through declared `shadcn-local-patches`;
- the console's global dialog and overlay rules in `ui/apps/console/src/index.css`, retired into the components;
- `ui/packages/plugin-form` modal width and column rules (`autoLayout.ts`), and the create flow for 「连续创建」;
- the console create entry points, including `AppContent.tsx`;
- new `@object-ui/i18n` keys (all locales, zh-Hant by the generator);
- one optional `ModalFormSchema` property in `@object-ui/types`;
- tests, and a changeset.
Estimated 1200–1800 lines, one PR.
Container & model: `M/L`, own card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening), from one optional `ModalFormSchema` property and new i18n keys. No spec or form-schema key: 「连续创建」 lives in the components and the console. The seat runs the declaration L2.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, main `be91bfc2`): holds. Evidence and before shots are in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35980/premise.md` and `before/`. The global rules in `index.css` (radius and overlay) also hit every popover (Radix Popover is `role="dialog"` too), the bottom sheet, the phone full-screen page and the side drawer's overlay.
Basis: card #35980 (p2, epic #34571; the maintainer listed it under the epic 2026-11-21 07:59:12Z and said 「立卡」 on its six suggestions).
Seat's reading of item 4 (width by field count): the maintainer approved 「字段少的用单列加窄一档；字段多的才排两列」 when filing the card, so a single column for a small undeclared form is the card's direction. That overrides the earlier "at least two columns in a modal" default (objectui#12521, #34607) and the effect of ruling 6204264665 (an undeclared group in a modal gets two per row). Both grouped and flat forms follow the total field count: 8 or fewer fields get a single column at the 672 size. Forms that declare columns or a width keep their declaration. The PR body states this reversal in its first lines, so the maintainer sees it at review, and the width change is its own commit, last, so it can be changed or dropped without touching the rest.
Other readings:
A. Popovers keep today's radius and shadow (card: small floats unchanged), and the rules move off `role="dialog"`.
B. The drawer overlay moves into the drawer component and looks the same.
C. At 375 the full-screen dialog keeps the full-screen behaviour, with square corners.
D. The outer ring has no backdrop blur (the frame is overflow-hidden); it is drawn as a ring shadow.
E. The title carries the object icon now, and switches to #35985's colour tile when that lands.
F. 「连续创建」 appears in list create and child-record create, not in a lookup's "+ New". It does not navigate to the new record. The toggle is remembered per object in the browser, which stands for the card's "per person" on that device.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. Overlap: #36014 shares `AppContent.tsx`; #35956 PR 2 (stage dialog onto `RequiredFieldsDialog`) builds in parallel. Whichever lands second merges. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push. L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #35980`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T11:08Z · Dialog single column (item 4 of this card): the maintainer chose on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-21 11:07:53Z: **dialogs with up to 6 fields and no declared column count lay out in one column.** 7 and 8 fields keep two columns, as today; 9 and more are unchanged. A declared `columns` on the form or a section, an authored `modalSize` and a maximized dialog are drawn as written. Asked after a fable review, which found this reverses only the dev default "at least two columns" (objectui#12521, #34607), not the ruling recorded in 6204264665. Measured at 1366×768: 6 fields give a 566px dialog with no scrolling. PR #36038 sets `DIALOG_SINGLE_COLUMN_MAX_FIELDS` to 6 and moves its pins to 6 and 7 fields.
